description: This file defines hooks for a React component testing environment using Playwright's component testing with React 17. It imports lifecycle hooks, configuration types, and React routing components, and implements 'beforeMount' and 'afterMount' hooks to execute code during component mounting phases.

methods.name: beforeMount
methods.description: A hook called before the component mounts, allowing asynchronous setup based on provided configuration.

methods.name: afterMount
methods.description: A hook called after the component mounts, used here for logging purposes.
